context: Tests whether the agent correctly integrates the pidge v3 library into an async FastAPI endpoint, including correct client lifecycle management, configuration from environment variables, message construction, delivery confirmation, error handling, and response structure.

checklist.name: Async context manager
checklist.description: Uses `async with NotificationClient(...) as client:` pattern — client is not stored as a long-lived instance variable or used outside the context manager

checklist.name: NotificationConfig from env
checklist.description: API key is read from an environment variable (e.g. os.environ or os.getenv), NOT hardcoded as a string literal in NotificationConfig

checklist.name: Message keyword arguments
checklist.description: Message is constructed using named keyword arguments (to=, subject=, body=), not positional arguments

checklist.name: Uses dispatch not send
checklist.description: Calls `client.dispatch(msg)` (awaited) — does NOT call `.send()` or any v2 method

checklist.name: Delivery confirmation check
checklist.description: Checks either `result.success` or `result.status == Status.SENT` after dispatch to determine if the notification succeeded

checklist.name: Logs message_id
checklist.description: Logs `result.message_id` after a successful dispatch (e.g. logger.info with message_id)

checklist.name: DispatchError caught explicitly
checklist.description: Imports and catches `DispatchError` from pidge in a try/except block around the dispatch call

checklist.name: No 500 on DispatchError
checklist.description: When DispatchError is caught, the endpoint returns a graceful response (not raises or re-raises the error resulting in a 500)

checklist.name: notification_sent in response
checklist.description: The endpoint response includes a `notification_sent` field set to True or False

checklist.name: No v2 API usage
checklist.description: Does NOT import or use `Notifier`, `NotifierConfig`, or `.send()` anywhere in the code
